_comment: Small card pool tuned for structured-search assertions. Same shape as a YGOProDeck dump so the normal ingest path can load it.

data.name: Testcase Dragon Alpha
data.desc: Banish 1 LIGHT monster from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dragon monster from your Extra Deck.

data.name: Testcase Fiend Beta
data.desc: If this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 DARK monster from your Deck to your hand.

data.name: Testcase Mystic Spell
data.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

data.name: Testcase Big Dragon
data.desc: Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.

data.name: Testcase Counter Trap
data.desc: When a monster would be Summoned: Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster.

data.name: Testcase Grave Tender
data.desc: You can banish 1 monster from your GY; add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand.
